exposure: Reversal of the Term Breech Trial findings regarding appropriate delivery of term breech births
cohort: The study included infants born with breech presentation in the United States between 1995 and 2010, using data from Birth Certificate Records.
finding: The reversal of the Term Breech Trial findings led to a 15%-23% decline in C-sections for term breech births, particularly among traditionally disadvantaged groups and young physicians, without significantly impacting infant health outcomes (low Apgar or low birth weight).
mod_finding: The reversal of the Term Breech Trial led to a 15%-23% decline in C-sections for term breech births, at a time when the overall trend in C-sections was rising.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome (low birth weight)
